description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class `EmployeeReportingMethodDao` responsible for managing employee reporting relationships (supervisors and subordinates) within an HRM system. It includes methods for saving, searching, deleting, and retrieving reporting data related to employees.

classes.name: EmployeeReportingMethodDao
classes.description: DAO class for handling employee reporting relationships, including CRUD operations and searches for supervisors and subordinates.

methods.name: saveEmployeeReportTo
methods.description: Persists a ReportTo entity representing a reporting relationship and returns it.

methods.name: searchImmediateEmployeeSupervisors
methods.description: Returns a list of immediate supervisors for an employee based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeSupervisorPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator object for searching employee supervisors based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeSubordinatePaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator for searching employee subordinates.

methods.name: getSearchImmediateEmployeeSupervisorsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of supervisors matching search criteria.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeSupervisors
methods.description: Deletes specified supervisor relationships for an employee.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeSubordinates
methods.description: Deletes specified subordinate relationships for an employee.

methods.name: searchEmployeeSubordinates
methods.description: Returns a list of subordinates for an employee based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeSubordinatesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of subordinates matching search criteria.

methods.name: getEmployeeReportToByEmpNumbers
methods.description: Fetches a specific ReportTo record representing the supervisor-reportee relationship between two employees.

methods.name: getExistingSubordinateIdsForEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns subordinate IDs for a given supervisor and a list of subordinate IDs.

methods.name: getExistingSupervisorIdsForEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns supervisor IDs for a given subordinate and a list of supervisor IDs.
